question.text: The Registration Certificate of a Category III AIF is:

answer.text: Valid till the fund is wound up

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 5.2.4, Registration Certificate is valid until the AIF is wound up (not time-bound). The Trap: Fixed-period validity is incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Same across categories. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Certificate surrender is required at wind-up — note the requirement in the wind-up checklist.
